command: for x in $(seq -100 100); do lhs=$(( (x + 1) * (x - 1) )); rhs=$(( x * x - 1 )); if [ "$lhs" -eq "$rhs" ]; then status="OK"; else status="COUNTEREXAMPLE"; fi; printf 'x = %5d   LHS = %10d   RHS = %10d   %s\n' "$x" "$lhs" "$rhs" "$status"; done >> /home/agent/workspace/counterexample_check.txt
